text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- United States officials are due to come to Bosnia on December 13 to mediate an agreement between the partners in the Moslem-Croat federation on creating government and appointing president and vice president, the daily quotes state news agency as saying.

- The Bosnian Serb defence minister visited disputed Bosnian town of Brcko on Monday saying he was there because of the danger of military intervention in the Serb entity, the daily quoted a news agency as saying.
- German troops are preparing to come to Bosnia as a part of NATO led force, although Bonn parliament has yet not made such decision, the correspondent in Bonn says.

- The Moslem-Croat federation will accept any decision of the international arbitration body about the town Brcko if that decision is based on justice and morality, vice president of the federation, Ejup Ganic, says in an interview. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
